text: Visiting the zoo is always an exciting adventure. From the moment you step through the gates, the sounds of animals fill the air, creating a lively atmosphere. You can wander through various exhibits, marveling at the majestic lions lounging in the sun or the playful monkeys swinging from branch to branch. Each enclosure offers a glimpse into the lives of these incredible creatures, making it easy to lose track of time. Whether you're watching the graceful movements of the giraffes or the vibrant colors of tropical birds, a day at the zoo is a delightful way to connect with nature and learn about wildlife conservation.

Albert Einstein was a brilliant physicist known for his groundbreaking theories, especially the theory of relativity. He was born in Germany in 1879 and later moved to Switzerland, where he developed many of his ideas. Einstein's work changed how we understand space, time, and gravity, making him one of the most famous scientists in history.
